user.title: WRM Systems Water
user.description: Configure connection to your WRM Systems smart water meter (e.g. Kaarinan Vesihuolto).

history.title: Historical Water Consumption
history.description:
Water meter connected successfully!

Historical data is available from **{earliest_date}** (initial reading: **{earliest_m3} m³**, latest reading: **{latest_m3} m³**).

The calendar is preset to the earliest available date. You can keep it to import all history, or select a custom date (e.g. your move-in date):

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to WRM Systems portal. Check internet connection and portal status.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check customer number and meter serial.
error.no_readings: Connected successfully, but no water meter readings were returned.

abort.already_configured: This water meter is already configured in Home Assistant.
